deploybot: preflight: prompt/eval gate FAILED for release v2.18.2 on summarizer prompt-suite. metric: ROUGE-L delta -2.9% (regression), 5/40 noisy cases. Blocking promotion unless exception approved or targeted pin/rollback. report: https://internal.redwood/evals/4977777777 :warning:
nora: can you paste the top failing examples? worried about anything customer-visible in release notes.
deploybot: top failures (short):
1) "Summary: product pricing update" -> dropped sentence about deprecated plan
2) "Executive TL;DR" -> omitted runbook step
3) "Onboarding email summary" -> misattributed owner team
noisy: tests 12, 19 variable. systemic: tests 1,2 reproduce.
devin: did we change tokenization or decoder temp yesterday?
anya: only quant profile moved v4->v5 (tighter rounding) and decoder sampling tweak sampling_beta=0.95. local reproducer points to sampling_beta causing omission. decoder rollback to sampling_beta=0.9 restores baseline.
nora: product: the deprecated-plan line is in release notes and docs. If summaries remove it customers will be confused. proposal: do a global quick pin to older decoder sampling to ship, then hotfix sampling after triage.
kai: QA: repro on staging with sampling_beta=0.95. region-scoped pin possible but complexity is high; global pin can be done in ~15m.
sam: ops: global pin is straightforward. regional pins are doable too but add config overhead.
devin: suggested sequence: 1) global pin to sampling_beta=0.9 for summarizer 2) create RD-8123 ticket to bisect sampling changes 3) prepare canary with sampling_beta=0.92 and run small A/B.
nora: product approves pin. add short release note: "Serving variant temporarily set to preserve critical migration notes; sampling improvements to be reintroduced after validation."
anya: starting bisect, suspect decoder post-processing filter in module POST_PROC.
kai: QA will run targeted sweep after pin.
deploybot: pin command ready:
/deploybot pin-model --service summarizer --tag sampling_v0.9 --scope global --reason "preflight regression: summarizer prompt-suite"
sam: executing now.
sam: pin completed at 4977777802 	6 signal re-run queued.
deploybot: re-run done at 4977777810: preflight PASS (ROUGE-L delta -0.1%). marking gate cleared for release; keep bisect ticket open.
nora: thanks all 8079; updating release notes and notifying support. keeping thread open for post-mortem notes.
devin: filed RD-8123 and assigned to @anya. est 2d.
